what: The garments the clothing session hands the builder (NOW.md, Handovers), fitted on the cast in Unreal: each skinned FBX is imported onto the wearer's body skeleton in the MetaHuman project (tools/ue/import_garments.py, under /Game/Ledger/MetaHumans/Garments, never in the public repository, which the build machine mirrors with the cast) and worn in the game by following the body's pose (LedgerGarments.h). 'hides' names the parts of Epic's outfit a garment replaces ('shoes': the part whose top is within 25 cm of the soles, since Epic's outfit pieces are named only Outfits, _2 and _3); 'raise_mm' lifts the wearer so soles stand on the ground (MetaHumans stand barefoot on the floor since 5.6); 'hold' keeps a garment off until the reason given is dealt with.

garments.name: RonBoots
garments.maps_note: 30 October: leather maps (tools/meshgen/blender/footwear_maps.py): UVs cut along a derby's seams, pebbled grain, stitched quarters and welt, the sole edge, scuffs; the weights unchanged (re-exported with UVs, the 30 September file kept)

soles.made: tools/meshgen/blender/sole_footprints.py on this garment's fbx (30 October): each half sole's footprint, along and across the foot from the ball joint, and the sole's floor

stand_in_held.why: 1 November, his yes of 31 October (the toe band's third try): a hidden copy of each half sole that only Lumen's light sees (Affect Indirect Lighting While Hidden), its bounds enlarged past Lumen's 30 cm cull (r.Lumen.DiffuseIndirect.MeshSDF.RadiusThreshold), so the wet floor under a toe reflects the sole, not the sky
stand_in_held.held: 1 November: no change to the band, standing on the floor or lifted 6 mm; and the band shows under a drawn, solid stand-in too, so it belongs to the wet ground's coat at any contact, not to the boots (the shoes plan, its last section); kept, not laid

soles.decal_note: Held 30 October (30 October: a decal writing no shine under each half sole (L...); laid again 2 November, 3.25 cm past each half sole (4 cm read as a dark halo seen whole; 2.5 cm let an arc of the line back before the toes), for the ground's coat cut at contacts (his yes of 07:54 to one more try at the pale line; M_LedgerGround reads it through the decal buffer).

garments.name: TomZipJacket
garments.made: Tom's zip jacket from Marvelous drape 19 with its cuffs built round his wrist in the bake (his order C9; tools/md/build_cuffs.py --edge-at-hand --gather; DECISIONS.md, 29 October), skinned again on 30 October as the jacket's own recipe says (skin_garment.py --piece-attr none --collar-attr piece:10 --keep-correctives): withdrawn on 29 October after holes and a right sleeve almost gone in the packaged game, it had been skinned without --piece-attr none, so its pattern piece 3, the right sleeve, was taken for a button and all its points given one averaged set of weights, and its export carried the flat pattern's UV layout first, so the game read the maps through it and the colour map's alpha cut holes. skin_garment.py now refuses a 'button' wider than 6 cm and puts the maps' layout first (uv_order.py). Every pose matches drape 19's (garment_pose_check.py); the editor's sit film passed a fresh reviewer. Maps from the built cuffs' bake. Known faults kept from drape 19: a small opening at the collar's front left of the zip seen standing, a bright patch in each elbow's crook, the lowered arms sinking into the sides, a crumple at the left hip, side-fold spikes. Navy (tint linear 0.082, 0.107, 0.247 on the 0.53 grey: about navy cotton) until he chooses its colour.

garments.name: TomJeans
garments.made: Tom's 1990 jeans (his order C9): FreeSewing's Titan at his size, draped in Marvelous over a smoothed hull of his boots (drape n7, short settling calls; the straight 16.5 in hem resting on the boots, its back about 5.3 cm up, his word of 30 October), bent back to his pose, 9,728 triangles, maps at 2048 (1.43 px/mm; 1024 fell under the 0.9 floor), skinned from his body with each leg from its own leg and the crotch faded to the pelvis over 7 cm (skin_garment.py --leg-sides --crotch-fade); the crotch's two layers between his near-touching thighs listed; the seat and crotch stretched sitting (6.0x) and the knees through by up to 16.5 mm in a hand-posed sit, both to be judged in the game. Tint: a faded 1990 mid-blue (sRGB about 95, 125, 165; the first, 72, 98, 140, read as a matched set with the navy jacket to its reviewer), his to approve.
garments.held_until: until its editor walk and a fresh reviewer pass (30 October; worn with -WearHeld=TomJeans)
garments.worn_since: 2026-10-30: worn by default with his body cut under the outfit (the MetaHuman hidden-face build, tools/ue/hidden_faces.py); his page next
garments.two_sided_why: 2 November: the packaged sit film showed a small hole behind the left knee as he sat (the cloth folding through itself, the body cut away under it); the back faces drawn too (tools/ue/import_garments.py).

garments.name: TomJumper

garments.hold: 30 October, 17:20: always under his zipped jacket, so never seen; drawing its neckband put a dark band outside the jacket's collar (the second outfit review), so it is held until the jacket is ever worn open
